pool.text: Let \(L = \lim_{n \to \infty} \sqrt[n]{a_n}\) be the limit obtained when applying the Root Test to the series \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^{2n}\). What is the exact value of \(L\)?
pool.text_ar: لتكن \(L = \lim_{n \to \infty} \sqrt[n]{a_n}\) هي النهاية الناتجة عند تطبيق اختبار الجذر على المتسلسلة \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^{2n}\). ما هي القيمة الدقيقة لـ \(L\)؟
pool.sol: Here \(a_n = \left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^{2n}\), which is positive for all \(n \ge 1\). Taking the \(n\)-th root gives \(\sqrt[n]{a_n} = \left(\left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^{2n}\right)^{1/n} = \left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^2\). Now compute the limit as \(n \to \infty\): \(L = \lim_{n \to \infty} \left(\frac{3 + \frac{2}{n}}{4 - \frac{1}{n}}\right)^2 = \left(\frac{3}{4}\right)^2 = \frac{9}{16}\). (Since \(L = \frac{9}{16} < 1\), the series converges.)
pool.sol_ar: هنا \(a_n = \left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^{2n}\)، وهو مقدار موجب لكل \(n \ge 1\). بأخذ الجذر النوني نحصل على \(\sqrt[n]{a_n} = \left(\left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^{2n}\right)^{1/n} = \left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^2\). الآن نحسب النهاية عندما \(n \to \infty\): \(L = \lim_{n \to \infty} \left(\frac{3 + \frac{2}{n}}{4 - \frac{1}{n}}\right)^2 = \left(\frac{3}{4}\right)^2 = \frac{9}{16}\). (وبما أن \(L = \frac{9}{16} < 1\)، فإن المتسلسلة متقاربة.)
hints: Raise \(a_n = \left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^{2n}\) to the power \(\frac{1}{n}\) and simplify the exponent.
Notice that the exponent \(2n \cdot \frac{1}{n}\) simplifies to \(2\), not \(1\), before taking the limit as \(n \to \infty\).
Since \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1} = \frac{3}{4}\), squaring this ratio gives \(L = \left(\frac{3}{4}\right)^2 = \frac{9}{16}\).
hints_ar: ارفع \(a_n = \left(\frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1}\right)^{2n}\) إلى الأس \(\frac{1}{n}\) وبسّط الأس.
لاحظ أن الأس \(2n \cdot \frac{1}{n}\) يتبسط إلى \(2\) وليس \(1\)، وذلك قبل أخذ النهاية عندما \(n \to \infty\).
بما أن \(\lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{3n + 2}{4n - 1} = \frac{3}{4}\)، فإن تربيع هذه النسبة يعطي \(L = \left(\frac{3}{4}\right)^2 = \frac{9}{16}\).
pool.sympy_cert:

a_n = ((3*n + 2) / (4*n - 1))**(2*n)
EXPECTED = sp.limit(a_n**(1/n), n, sp.oo)

pool.text: When applying the Integral Test to confirm the convergence of \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n e^{-n^2}\), what is the exact value of the improper integral \(\int_{1}^{\infty} x e^{-x^2}\,dx\)?
pool.text_ar: عند تطبيق اختبار التكامل لتأكيد تقارب المتسلسلة \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n e^{-n^2}\)، ما هي القيمة الدقيقة للتكامل المعتل \(\int_{1}^{\infty} x e^{-x^2}\,dx\)؟
pool.sol: Rewrite the improper integral as a limit: \(\int_{1}^{\infty} x e^{-x^2}\,dx = \lim_{b \to \infty} \int_{1}^{b} x e^{-x^2}\,dx\). Use the substitution \(u = -x^2\), so \(du = -2x\,dx\) and \(x\,dx = -\frac{1}{2}\,du\). An antiderivative of \(x e^{-x^2}\) is \(-\frac{1}{2} e^{-x^2}\). Evaluating from \(1\) to \(b\) gives \(\lim_{b \to \infty} \left[-\frac{1}{2} e^{-b^2} + \frac{1}{2} e^{-1}\right]\). Since \(\lim_{b \to \infty} e^{-b^2} = 0\), the value of the improper integral is \(\frac{1}{2} e^{-1} = \frac{1}{2e}\).
pool.sol_ar: نعيد كتابة التكامل المعتل كنهاية: \(\int_{1}^{\infty} x e^{-x^2}\,dx = \lim_{b \to \infty} \int_{1}^{b} x e^{-x^2}\,dx\). نستخدم التعويض \(u = -x^2\)، فيكون \(du = -2x\,dx\) ومنه \(x\,dx = -\frac{1}{2}\,du\). الدالة الأصلية لـ \(x e^{-x^2}\) هي \(-\frac{1}{2} e^{-x^2}\). بالتعويض بحدي التكامل من \(1\) إلى \(b\) نحصل على \(\lim_{b \to \infty} \left[-\frac{1}{2} e^{-b^2} + \frac{1}{2} e^{-1}\right]\). وبما أن \(\lim_{b \to \infty} e^{-b^2} = 0\)، فإن قيمة التكامل المعتل هي \(\frac{1}{2} e^{-1} = \frac{1}{2e}\).
hints: Use the substitution \(u = -x^2\) to find an antiderivative of \(x e^{-x^2}\).
Remember the factor of \(-\frac{1}{2}\) from \(du = -2x\,dx\), then express the improper integral as \(\lim_{b \to \infty} \left[-\frac{1}{2} e^{-x^2}\right]_{1}^{b}\).
Since \(e^{-b^2} \to 0\) as \(b \to \infty\), the integral evaluates to \(0 - \left(-\frac{1}{2} e^{-1}\right) = \frac{1}{2e}\).
hints_ar: استخدم التعويض \(u = -x^2\) لإيجاد الدالة الأصلية للمقدار \(x e^{-x^2}\).
تذكر المعامل \(-\frac{1}{2}\) الناتج من \(du = -2x\,dx\)، ثم اكتب التكامل المعتل على الصورة \(\lim_{b \to \infty} \left[-\frac{1}{2} e^{-x^2}\right]_{1}^{b}\).
بما أن \(e^{-b^2} \to 0\) عندما \(b \to \infty\)، فإن قيمة التكامل تساوي \(0 - \left(-\frac{1}{2} e^{-1}\right) = \frac{1}{2e}\).
pool.sympy_cert:

pool.text: Using term-by-term differentiation of a geometric power series, evaluate the exact sum \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{n}{3^n}\).
pool.text_ar: باستخدام اشتقاق متسلسلة القوى الهندسية حداً بحداً، أوجد القيمة الدقيقة للمجموع \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{n}{3^n}\).
pool.sol: For \(|x| < 1\), the geometric series gives \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} x^n = \frac{1}{1 - x}\). Differentiating both sides with respect to \(x\) yields \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n x^{n-1} = \frac{1}{(1 - x)^2}\). Multiply both sides by \(x\) to match the required exponent: \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n x^n = \frac{x}{(1 - x)^2}\) for \(|x| < 1\). Substituting \(x = \frac{1}{3}\) (which satisfies \(|x| < 1\)), we obtain \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{n}{3^n} = \frac{\frac{1}{3}}{\left(1 - \frac{1}{3}\right)^2} = \frac{\frac{1}{3}}{\frac{4}{9}} = \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{9}{4} = \frac{3}{4}\).
pool.sol_ar: لقيم \(|x| < 1\)، تعطي المتسلسلة الهندسية \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} x^n = \frac{1}{1 - x}\). باشتقاق الطرفين بالنسبة إلى \(x\) نحصل على \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n x^{n-1} = \frac{1}{(1 - x)^2}\). نضرب الطرفين في \(x\) لمطابقة الأس المطلوب: \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n x^n = \frac{x}{(1 - x)^2}\) لكل \(|x| < 1\). بتعويض \(x = \frac{1}{3}\) (وهي تحقق \(|x| < 1\))، نحصل على \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{n}{3^n} = \frac{\frac{1}{3}}{\left(1 - \frac{1}{3}\right)^2} = \frac{\frac{1}{3}}{\frac{4}{9}} = \frac{1}{3} \cdot \frac{9}{4} = \frac{3}{4}\).
hints: Begin with \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} x^n = \frac{1}{1 - x}\) for \(|x| < 1\) and differentiate both sides with respect to \(x\).
Notice that differentiating gives \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n x^{n-1} = \frac{1}{(1 - x)^2}\); multiply both sides by \(x\) so the general term becomes \(n x^n\).
Substitute \(x = \frac{1}{3}\) into \(\frac{x}{(1 - x)^2}\) to get \(\frac{1/3}{(2/3)^2} = \frac{3}{4}\).
hints_ar: ابدأ بالمتسلسلة \(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} x^n = \frac{1}{1 - x}\) حيث \(|x| < 1\) واشتق الطرفين بالنسبة إلى \(x\).
لاحظ أن الاشتقاق يعطي \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} n x^{n-1} = \frac{1}{(1 - x)^2}\)؛ اضرب الطرفين في \(x\) ليصبح الحد العام \(n x^n\).
عوّض \(x = \frac{1}{3}\) في الصيغة \(\frac{x}{(1 - x)^2}\) لتحصل على \(\frac{1/3}{(2/3)^2} = \frac{3}{4}\).
pool.sympy_cert:
n = sp.Symbol('n', positive=True, integer=True)
EXPECTED = sp.summation(n / sp.Integer(3)**n, (n, 1, sp.oo))

pool.text: Suppose the series \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{2n^2 + 5n}{\sqrt{9n^7 + 4n^3 + 1}}\) is tested for convergence using the Limit Comparison Test with \(b_n = \frac{1}{n^{3/2}}\). What is the value of the comparison limit \(c = \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{a_n}{b_n}\)?
pool.text_ar: بافتراض اختبار تقارب المتسلسلة \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} \frac{2n^2 + 5n}{\sqrt{9n^7 + 4n^3 + 1}}\) باستخدام اختبار المقارنة بالنهاية مع \(b_n = \frac{1}{n^{3/2}}\). ما هي قيمة نهاية المقارنة \(c = \lim_{n \to \infty} \frac{a_n}{b_n}\)؟
pool.sol: Let \(a_n = \frac{2n^2 + 5n}{\sqrt{9n^7 + 4n^3 + 1}}\) and \(b_n = \frac{1}{n^{3/2}}\). Dividing \(a_n\) by \(b_n\) is equivalent to multiplying \(a_n\) by \(n^{3/2}\): \(\frac{a_n}{b_n} = \frac{(2n^2 + 5n) n^{3/2}}{\sqrt{9n^7 + 4n^3 + 1}} = \frac{2n^{7/2} + 5n^{5/2}}{\sqrt{9n^7 + 4n^3 + 1}}\). Divide numerator and denominator by \(n^{7/2} = \sqrt{n^7}\): \(\frac{a_n}{b_n} = \frac{2 + \frac{5}{n}}{\sqrt{9 + \frac{4}{n^4} + \frac{1}{n^7}}}\). Taking the limit as \(n \to \infty\) yields \(c = \frac{2 + 0}{\sqrt{9 + 0 + 0}} = \frac{2}{3}\). (Since \(0 < c < \infty\) and \(\sum \frac{1}{n^{3/2}}\) is a convergent \(p\)-series with \(p = \frac{3}{2} > 1\), the given series also converges.)
pool.sol_ar: ليكن \(a_n = \frac{2n^2 + 5n}{\sqrt{9n^7 + 4n^3 + 1}}\) و \(b_n = \frac{1}{n^{3/2}}\). قسمة \(a_n\) على \(b_n\) تكافئ ضرب \(a_n\) في \(n^{3/2}\): \(\frac{a_n}{b_n} = \frac{(2n^2 + 5n) n^{3/2}}{\sqrt{9n^7 + 4n^3 + 1}} = \frac{2n^{7/2} + 5n^{5/2}}{\sqrt{9n^7 + 4n^3 + 1}}\). نقسم البسط والمقام على \(n^{7/2} = \sqrt{n^7}\): \(\frac{a_n}{b_n} = \frac{2 + \frac{5}{n}}{\sqrt{9 + \frac{4}{n^4} + \frac{1}{n^7}}}\). بأخذ النهاية عندما \(n \to \infty\) نحصل على \(c = \frac{2 + 0}{\sqrt{9 + 0 + 0}} = \frac{2}{3}\). (وبما أن \(0 < c < \infty\) والمتسلسلة \(\sum \frac{1}{n^{3/2}}\) هي متسلسلة \(p\) متقاربة حيث \(p = \frac{3}{2} > 1\)، فإن المتسلسلة المعطاة متقاربة أيضاً.)
hints: Form the ratio \(\frac{a_n}{b_n}\) by multiplying the numerator \(2n^2 + 5n\) by \(n^{3/2}\).
Note that \(n^2 \cdot n^{3/2} = n^{7/2}\) and \(\sqrt{9n^7} = 3n^{7/2}\); divide both numerator and denominator by \(n^{7/2}\).
Taking the limit as \(n \to \infty\) gives \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{9}} = \frac{2}{3}\).
hints_ar: كوّن النسبة \(\frac{a_n}{b_n}\) بضرب البسط \(2n^2 + 5n\) في \(n^{3/2}\).
لاحظ أن \(n^2 \cdot n^{3/2} = n^{7/2}\) وأن \(\sqrt{9n^7} = 3n^{7/2}\)؛ اقسم كلاً من البسط والمقام على \(n^{7/2}\).
أخذ النهاية عندما \(n \to \infty\) يعطي \(\frac{2}{\sqrt{9}} = \frac{2}{3}\).
pool.sympy_cert:
n = sp.Symbol('n', positive=True)
a_n = (2*n**2 + 5*n) / sp.sqrt(9*n**7 + 4*n**3 + 1)
b_n = 1 / n**sp.Rational(3, 2)
EXPECTED = sp.limit(a_n / b_n, n, sp.oo)

pool.text: A particle moves in the \(xy\)-plane so that its position vector at time \(t\) is \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^2 - 3t, \, 2t^3 - 6t \rangle\). What is the speed of the particle when \(t = 2\)?
pool.text_ar: يتحرك جسيم في المستوى \(xy\) بحيث يكون متجه موضعه عند الزمن \(t\) هو \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^2 - 3t, \, 2t^3 - 6t \rangle\). ما مقدار سرعة الجسيم عندما يكون \(t = 2\)؟
pool.sol: First, find the velocity vector \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{r}'(t)\) by differentiating each component with respect to \(t\): \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 2t - 3, \, 6t^2 - 6 \rangle\). Evaluating at \(t = 2\) gives \(\mathbf{v}(2) = \langle 2(2) - 3, \, 6(2)^2 - 6 \rangle = \langle 1, \, 18 \rangle\). The speed is the magnitude of the velocity vector: \(\|\mathbf{v}(2)\| = \sqrt{1^2 + 18^2} = \sqrt{1 + 324} = \sqrt{325}\).
pool.sol_ar: أولاً، نوجد متجه السرعة \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{r}'(t)\) باشتقاق كل مركبة بالنسبة إلى \(t\): \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 2t - 3, \, 6t^2 - 6 \rangle\). بالتعويض عند \(t = 2\) نحصل على \(\mathbf{v}(2) = \langle 2(2) - 3, \, 6(2)^2 - 6 \rangle = \langle 1, \, 18 \rangle\). مقدار السرعة هو طول متجه السرعة: \(\|\mathbf{v}(2)\| = \sqrt{1^2 + 18^2} = \sqrt{1 + 324} = \sqrt{325}\).
hints: Recall that the velocity vector \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) is the component-wise derivative of the position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\), and speed is the magnitude \(\|\mathbf{v}(t)\|\).
Differentiating gives \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 2t - 3, \, 6t^2 - 6 \rangle\). Substitute \(t = 2\) to find the components of \(\mathbf{v}(2)\).
With \(\mathbf{v}(2) = \langle 1, 18 \rangle\), compute \(\sqrt{1^2 + 18^2} = \sqrt{325}\).
hints_ar: تذكر أن متجه السرعة \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) هو مشتقة مركبات متجه الموضع \(\mathbf{r}(t)\)، وأن مقدار السرعة هو الطول \(\|\mathbf{v}(t)\|\).
الاشتقاق يعطي \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 2t - 3, \, 6t^2 - 6 \rangle\). عوّض بـ \(t = 2\) لإيجاد مركبتي \(\mathbf{v}(2)\).
بما أن \(\mathbf{v}(2) = \langle 1, 18 \rangle\)، احسب \(\sqrt{1^2 + 18^2} = \sqrt{325}\).
pool.sympy_cert: t = sp.Symbol('t', real=True); vx = sp.diff(t**2 - 3*t, t).subs(t, 2); vy = sp.diff(2*t**3 - 6*t, t).subs(t, 2); EXPECTED = sp.sqrt(vx**2 + vy**2)

pool.text: What is the exact length of the curve given by the vector-valued function \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle 2t^{3/2}, \, 3t - 1 \rangle\) on the interval \(0 \le t \le 3\)?
pool.text_ar: ما الطول الدقيق للمنحنى المعطى بالدالة المتجهة \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle 2t^{3/2}, \, 3t - 1 \rangle\) على الفترة \(0 \le t \le 3\)؟
pool.sol: The arc length formula is \(L = \int_{0}^{3} \sqrt{(x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2} \, dt\). Compute the derivatives: \(x'(t) = 3t^{1/2}\) and \(y'(t) = 3\). Then \((x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2 = 9t + 9 = 9(t + 1)\). Substituting into the integral yields \(L = \int_{0}^{3} \sqrt{9(t + 1)} \, dt = 3 \int_{0}^{3} (t + 1)^{1/2} \, dt\). Evaluating the antiderivative gives \(3 \left[ \frac{2}{3}(t + 1)^{3/2} \right]_{0}^{3} = 2(4^{3/2} - 1^{3/2}) = 2(8 - 1) = 14\).
hints: Use the parametric arc length integral \(L = \int_{a}^{b} \sqrt{(x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2} \, dt\).
Differentiate the components to get \(x'(t) = 3\sqrt{t}\) and \(y'(t) = 3\), so the integrand simplifies to \(3\sqrt{t + 1}\).
hints_ar: استخدم تكامل طول القوس الوسيطي \(L = \int_{a}^{b} \sqrt{(x'(t))^2 + (y'(t))^2} \, dt\).
اشتق المركبات لتحصل على \(x'(t) = 3\sqrt{t}\) و \(y'(t) = 3\)، فيتبسط المكامل إلى \(3\sqrt{t + 1}\).
pool.sympy_cert: t = sp.Symbol('t', positive=True); dx = sp.diff(2*t**sp.Rational(3,2), t); dy = sp.diff(3*t - 1, t); EXPECTED = sp.integrate(sp.sqrt(dx**2 + dy**2), (t, 0, 3))

pool.text: A particle moves in the \(xy\)-plane with acceleration vector \(\mathbf{a}(t) = \langle 6t, \, 4e^{2t} \rangle\) for \(t \ge 0\). At \(t = 0\), the velocity is \(\mathbf{v}(0) = \langle -1, \, 3 \rangle\) and the position is \(\mathbf{r}(0) = \langle 2, \, 0 \rangle\). What is the \(x\)-coordinate plus the \(y\)-coordinate of the particle's position at \(t = 1\)?
pool.text_ar: يتحرك جسيم في المستوى \(xy\) بمتجه تسارع \(\mathbf{a}(t) = \langle 6t, \, 4e^{2t} \rangle\) حيث \(t \ge 0\). عند \(t = 0\)، تكون السرعة \(\mathbf{v}(0) = \langle -1, \, 3 \rangle\) والموضع \(\mathbf{r}(0) = \langle 2, \, 0 \rangle\). ما حاصل جمع الإحداثي \(x\) والإحداثي \(y\) لموضع الجسيم عند \(t = 1\)؟
pool.sol: Integrate \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) to find \(\mathbf{v}(t)\): \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 3t^2 + C_1, \, 2e^{2t} + C_2 \rangle\). Using \(\mathbf{v}(0) = \langle -1, \, 3 \rangle\), we get \(C_1 = -1\) and \(2 + C_2 = 3 \implies C_2 = 1\), so \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 3t^2 - 1, \, 2e^{2t} + 1 \rangle\). Integrate again to find \(\mathbf{r}(t)\): \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^3 - t + D_1, \, e^{2t} + t + D_2 \rangle\). Using \(\mathbf{r}(0) = \langle 2, \, 0 \rangle\), we find \(D_1 = 2\) and \(1 + D_2 = 0 \implies D_2 = -1\). Thus \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^3 - t + 2, \, e^{2t} + t - 1 \rangle\). At \(t = 1\), \(\mathbf{r}(1) = \langle 1 - 1 + 2, \, e^2 + 1 - 1 \rangle = \langle 2, \, e^2 \rangle\). The sum of the coordinates is \(2 + e^2 = e^2 + 2\).
pool.sol_ar: نكامل \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) لإيجاد \(\mathbf{v}(t)\): \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 3t^2 + C_1, \, 2e^{2t} + C_2 \rangle\). باستخدام \(\mathbf{v}(0) = \langle -1, \, 3 \rangle\)، نحصل على \(C_1 = -1\) و \(2 + C_2 = 3 \implies C_2 = 1\)، ومنه \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 3t^2 - 1, \, 2e^{2t} + 1 \rangle\). نكامل مرة أخرى لإيجاد \(\mathbf{r}(t)\): \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^3 - t + D_1, \, e^{2t} + t + D_2 \rangle\). باستخدام \(\mathbf{r}(0) = \langle 2, \, 0 \rangle\)، نجد \(D_1 = 2\) و \(1 + D_2 = 0 \implies D_2 = -1\). إذن \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^3 - t + 2, \, e^{2t} + t - 1 \rangle\). عند \(t = 1\)، يكون \(\mathbf{r}(1) = \langle 1 - 1 + 2, \, e^2 + 1 - 1 \rangle = \langle 2, \, e^2 \rangle\). مجموع الإحداثيين هو \(2 + e^2 = e^2 + 2\).
hints: Integrate \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) component-by-component and remember that \(\int e^{2t} \, dt = \frac{1}{2}e^{2t} + C\) does not vanish at \(t = 0\).

Applying \(\mathbf{v}(0) = \langle -1, 3 \rangle\) yields \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 3t^2 - 1, \, 2e^{2t} + 1 \rangle\). Now integrate \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) and apply \(\mathbf{r}(0) = \langle 2, 0 \rangle\).
From \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^3 - t + 2, \, e^{2t} + t - 1 \rangle\), evaluate at \(t = 1\) to get \(\langle 2, e^2 \rangle\), giving a sum of \(e^2 + 2\).
hints_ar: كامل \(\mathbf{a}(t)\) مركبةً بمركبة، وتذكر أن \(\int e^{2t} \, dt = \frac{1}{2}e^{2t} + C\) لا يساوي صفراً عند \(t = 0\).
بتطبيق الشرط \(\mathbf{v}(0) = \langle -1, 3 \rangle\) ينتج \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \langle 3t^2 - 1, \, 2e^{2t} + 1 \rangle\). كامل الآن \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) وطبق \(\mathbf{r}(0) = \langle 2, 0 \rangle\).
من \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^3 - t + 2, \, e^{2t} + t - 1 \rangle\)، عوّض بـ \(t = 1\) لتحصل على \(\langle 2, e^2 \rangle\)، فيكون المجموع \(e^2 + 2\).
pool.sympy_cert: t = sp.Symbol('t', real=True); vx = -1 + sp.integrate(6*t, (t, 0, t)); vy = 3 + sp.integrate(4*sp.exp(2*t), (t, 0, t)); rx = 2 + sp.integrate(vx, (t, 0, 1)); ry = 0 + sp.integrate(vy, (t, 0, 1)); EXPECTED = sp.simplify(rx + ry)

pool.text: A curve in the \(xy\)-plane is defined parametrically by \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^3 - 3t, \, t^2 + 4t \rangle\). What is the slope of the line tangent to the curve at the point corresponding to \(t = 2\)?
pool.text_ar: يُعرَّف منحنى في المستوى \(xy\) وسيطياً بالدالة \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^3 - 3t, \, t^2 + 4t \rangle\). ما ميل المستقيم المماس للمنحنى عند النقطة المقابلة لقيمة الوسيط \(t = 2\)؟
pool.sol: For a parametrically defined curve \(x(t) = t^3 - 3t\) and \(y(t) = t^2 + 4t\), the slope of the tangent line is given by \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\), provided \(\frac{dx}{dt} \neq 0\). Differentiating with respect to \(t\) gives \(\frac{dx}{dt} = 3t^2 - 3\) and \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 2t + 4\). Evaluating at \(t = 2\), we obtain \(\left.\frac{dx}{dt}\right|_{t=2} = 3(2)^2 - 3 = 9\) and \(\left.\frac{dy}{dt}\right|_{t=2} = 2(2) + 4 = 8\). Therefore, \(\left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{t=2} = \frac{8}{9}\).
pool.sol_ar: لمنحنى معرّف وسيطياً بـ \(x(t) = t^3 - 3t\) و \(y(t) = t^2 + 4t\)، يُعطى ميل المماس بالعلاقة \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\) بشرط أن \(\frac{dx}{dt} \neq 0\). بالاشتقاق بالنسبة إلى \(t\) نجد \(\frac{dx}{dt} = 3t^2 - 3\) و \(\frac{dy}{dt} = 2t + 4\). بالتعويض عند \(t = 2\)، نحصل على \(\left.\frac{dx}{dt}\right|_{t=2} = 3(2)^2 - 3 = 9\) و \(\left.\frac{dy}{dt}\right|_{t=2} = 2(2) + 4 = 8\). بالتالي فإن \(\left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{t=2} = \frac{8}{9}\).
hints: The slope of the tangent line to a parametric curve is \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y'(t)}{x'(t)}\), not \(\frac{y(t)}{x(t)}\).
Compute \(x'(t) = 3t^2 - 3\) and \(y'(t) = 2t + 4\), making sure to place \(y'(t)\) in the numerator.
hints_ar: ميل المماس لمنحنى وسيطي هو \(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{y'(t)}{x'(t)}\)، وليس \(\frac{y(t)}{x(t)}\).
احسب \(x'(t) = 3t^2 - 3\) و \(y'(t) = 2t + 4\)، مع التأكد من وضع \(y'(t)\) في البسط.
عند \(t = 2\)، يكون \(y'(2) = 8\) و \(x'(2) = 9\)، لذا فإن الميل يساوي \(\frac{8}{9}\).
pool.sympy_cert: t = sp.Symbol('t', real=True); x = t**3 - 3*t; y = t**2 + 4*t; EXPECTED = (sp.diff(y, t) / sp.diff(x, t)).subs(t, 2)

pool.text: Let \(\mathbf{u} = \langle 2, \, -3, \, 1 \rangle\) and \(\mathbf{v} = \langle k, \, 4, \, -2 \rangle\) be vectors in \(\mathbb{R}^3\). For what value of \(k\) are \(\mathbf{u}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) orthogonal?
pool.text_ar: ليكن \(\mathbf{u} = \langle 2, \, -3, \, 1 \rangle\) و \(\mathbf{v} = \langle k, \, 4, \, -2 \rangle\) متجهين في \(\mathbb{R}^3\). ما قيمة \(k\) التي تجعل المتجهين \(\mathbf{u}\) و \(\mathbf{v}\) متعامدين؟
pool.sol: Two nonzero vectors \(\mathbf{u}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) are orthogonal if and only if their dot product is zero: \(\mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} = 0\). Computing the dot product gives \(2(k) + (-3)(4) + (1)(-2) = 2k - 12 - 2 = 2k - 14\). Setting \(2k - 14 = 0\) and solving for \(k\) yields \(2k = 14\), so \(k = 7\).
pool.sol_ar: يكون متجهان غير صفريين \(\mathbf{u}\) و \(\mathbf{v}\) متعامدين إذا وفقط إذا كان حاصل ضربهما القياسي يساوي صفراً: \(\mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} = 0\). بحساب الضرب القياسي نحصل على \(2(k) + (-3)(4) + (1)(-2) = 2k - 12 - 2 = 2k - 14\). بمساواة المقدار بالصفر \(2k - 14 = 0\) وحل المعادلة لإيجاد \(k\) ينتج \(2k = 14\)، ومنه \(k = 7\).
hints: Two vectors are orthogonal when their dot product \(\mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v}\) equals \(0\).
Multiply corresponding components and add them: \(2k + (-3)(4) + (1)(-2) = 0\).
Simplify \(2k - 14 = 0\) to find \(k = 7\).
hints_ar: يتعامد متجهان عندما يساوي حاصل ضربهما القياسي \(\mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v}\) القيمة \(0\).
اضرب المركبات المتناظرة واجمعها: \(2k + (-3)(4) + (1)(-2) = 0\).
بسّط المعادلة \(2k - 14 = 0\) لتجد أن \(k = 7\).
pool.sympy_cert: k = sp.Symbol('k', real=True); u = sp.Matrix([2, -3, 1]); v = sp.Matrix([k, 4, -2]); EXPECTED = sp.solve(u.dot(v), k)[0]

pool.text: Let \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^2, \, 2t, \, \ln t \rangle\) for \(t > 0\). If \(\mathbf{T}(t)\) is the unit tangent vector to the curve, what is the third component (the \(z\)-component) of \(\mathbf{T}(2)\)?
pool.text_ar: لتكن \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^2, \, 2t, \, \ln t \rangle\) حيث \(t > 0\). إذا كان \(\mathbf{T}(t)\) هو متجه الوحدة المماس للمنحنى، فما المركبة الثالثة (المركبة \(z\)) للمتجه \(\mathbf{T}(2)\)؟
pool.sol: The unit tangent vector is defined by \(\mathbf{T}(t) = \frac{\mathbf{r}'(t)}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|}\). Differentiating \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) gives \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \left\langle 2t, \, 2, \, \frac{1}{t} \right\rangle\). Evaluating at \(t = 2\), we have \(\mathbf{r}'(2) = \left\langle 4, \, 2, \, \frac{1}{2} \right\rangle\). Next, compute its magnitude: \(\|\mathbf{r}'(2)\| = \sqrt{4^2 + 2^2 + \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2} = \sqrt{16 + 4 + \frac{1}{4}} = \sqrt{\frac{81}{4}} = \frac{9}{2}\). Dividing the \(z\)-component of \(\mathbf{r}'(2)\) by \(\|\mathbf{r}'(2)\|\) gives \(\frac{1/2}{9/2} = \frac{1}{9}\).
pool.sol_ar: يُعرَّف متجه الوحدة المماس بالعلاقة \(\mathbf{T}(t) = \frac{\mathbf{r}'(t)}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|}\). باشتقاق \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) نحصل على \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \left\langle 2t, \, 2, \, \frac{1}{t} \right\rangle\). بالتعويض عند \(t = 2\)، نجد \(\mathbf{r}'(2) = \left\langle 4, \, 2, \, \frac{1}{2} \right\rangle\). بعد ذلك، نحسب طوله: \(\|\mathbf{r}'(2)\| = \sqrt{4^2 + 2^2 + \left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^2} = \sqrt{16 + 4 + \frac{1}{4}} = \sqrt{\frac{81}{4}} = \frac{9}{2}\). بقسمة المركبة \(z\) للمتجه \(\mathbf{r}'(2)\) على \(\|\mathbf{r}'(2)\|\) نحصل على \(\frac{1/2}{9/2} = \frac{1}{9}\).
hints: Recall the definition of the unit tangent vector: \(\mathbf{T}(t) = \frac{\mathbf{r}'(t)}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|}\).
Differentiate to get \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \langle 2t, \, 2, \, 1/t \rangle\), evaluate at \(t = 2\), and find the length \(\|\mathbf{r}'(2)\| = \sqrt{16 + 4 + \frac{1}{4}}\).
Since \(\|\mathbf{r}'(2)\| = \frac{9}{2}\) and the \(z\)-component of \(\mathbf{r}'(2)\) is \(\frac{1}{2}\), their ratio is \(\frac{1/2}{9/2} = \frac{1}{9}\).
hints_ar: تذكر تعريف متجه الوحدة المماس: \(\mathbf{T}(t) = \frac{\mathbf{r}'(t)}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|}\).
اشتق لتحصل على \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \langle 2t, \, 2, \, 1/t \rangle\)، وعوّض عند \(t = 2\)، ثم أوجد الطول \(\|\mathbf{r}'(2)\| = \sqrt{16 + 4 + \frac{1}{4}}\).
بما أن \(\|\mathbf{r}'(2)\| = \frac{9}{2}\) والمركبة \(z\) للمتجه \(\mathbf{r}'(2)\) هي \(\frac{1}{2}\)، فإن نسبتهما هي \(\frac{1/2}{9/2} = \frac{1}{9}\).
pool.sympy_cert: t = sp.Symbol('t', positive=True); r = sp.Matrix([t**2, 2*t, sp.log(t)]); dr = r.diff(t).subs(t, 2); EXPECTED = (dr / dr.norm())[2]

pool.text: What is the curvature \(\kappa\) of the space curve \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle 3\cos t, \, 3\sin t, \, 4t \rangle\) at \(t = \frac{\pi}{4}\)?
pool.text_ar: ما انحناء \(\kappa\) المنحنى الفضائي \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle 3\cos t, \, 3\sin t, \, 4t \rangle\) عند \(t = \frac{\pi}{4}\)؟
pool.sol: Compute the first and second derivatives: \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \langle -3\sin t, \, 3\cos t, \, 4 \rangle\) and \(\mathbf{r}''(t) = \langle -3\cos t, \, -3\sin t, \, 0 \rangle\). Notice that \(\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\| = \sqrt{9\sin^2 t + 9\cos^2 t + 16} = \sqrt{9 + 16} = 5\) is constant. Thus the unit tangent vector is \(\mathbf{T}(t) = \frac{1}{5}\langle -3\sin t, \, 3\cos t, \, 4 \rangle\), and \(\mathbf{T}'(t) = \frac{1}{5}\langle -3\cos t, \, -3\sin t, \, 0 \rangle\), which has constant magnitude \(\|\mathbf{T}'(t)\| = \frac{3}{5}\). Using \(\kappa(t) = \frac{\|\mathbf{T}'(t)\|}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|}\) at \(t = \frac{\pi}{4}\), we find \(\kappa = \frac{3/5}{5} = \frac{3}{25}\).
pool.sol_ar: نحسب المشتقتين الأولى والثانية: \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \langle -3\sin t, \, 3\cos t, \, 4 \rangle\) و \(\mathbf{r}''(t) = \langle -3\cos t, \, -3\sin t, \, 0 \rangle\). نلاحظ أن \(\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\| = \sqrt{9\sin^2 t + 9\cos^2 t + 16} = \sqrt{9 + 16} = 5\) مقدار ثابت. وعليه فإن متجه الوحدة المماس هو \(\mathbf{T}(t) = \frac{1}{5}\langle -3\sin t, \, 3\cos t, \, 4 \rangle\)، ومشتقته \(\mathbf{T}'(t) = \frac{1}{5}\langle -3\cos t, \, -3\sin t, \, 0 \rangle\)، والتي لها طول ثابت \(\|\mathbf{T}'(t)\| = \frac{3}{5}\). باستخدام الصيغة \(\kappa(t) = \frac{\|\mathbf{T}'(t)\|}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|}\) عند \(t = \frac{\pi}{4}\)، نجد أن \(\kappa = \frac{3/5}{5} = \frac{3}{25}\).
hints: You can compute curvature using either \(\kappa(t) = \frac{\|\mathbf{T}'(t)\|}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|}\) or \(\kappa(t) = \frac{\|\mathbf{r}'(t) \times \mathbf{r}''(t)\|}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|^3}\).

Find \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \langle -3\sin t, \, 3\cos t, \, 4 \rangle\) and observe that its magnitude \(\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\| = \sqrt{9 + 16} = 5\) is constant, making \(\mathbf{T}'(t)\) easy to differentiate.
Since \(\|\mathbf{T}'(t)\| = \frac{3}{5}\) and \(\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\| = 5\), divide them to get \(\kappa = \frac{3/5}{5} = \frac{3}{25}\).
hints_ar: يمكنك حساب الانحناء باستخدام الصيغة \(\kappa(t) = \frac{\|\mathbf{T}'(t)\|}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|}\) أو \(\kappa(t) = \frac{\|\mathbf{r}'(t) \times \mathbf{r}''(t)\|}{\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\|^3}\).
أوجد \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \langle -3\sin t, \, 3\cos t, \, 4 \rangle\) ولاحظ أن طوله \(\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\| = \sqrt{9 + 16} = 5\) ثابت، مما يسهّل اشتقاق \(\mathbf{T}'(t)\).
بما أن \(\|\mathbf{T}'(t)\| = \frac{3}{5}\) و \(\|\mathbf{r}'(t)\| = 5\)، اقسمهما لتحصل على \(\kappa = \frac{3/5}{5} = \frac{3}{25}\).
pool.sympy_cert: t = sp.Symbol('t', real=True); r = sp.Matrix([3*sp.cos(t), 3*sp.sin(t), 4*t]); dr = r.diff(t); ddr = dr.diff(t); kappa = (dr.cross(ddr)).norm() / (dr.norm()**3); EXPECTED = sp.simplify(kappa.subs(t, sp.pi/4))

pool.text: What is the area of the parallelogram in \(\mathbb{R}^3\) determined by the adjacent edge vectors \(\mathbf{u} = \langle 1, \, 2, \, -1 \rangle\) and \(\mathbf{v} = \langle 3, \, 0, \, 2 \rangle\)?
pool.text_ar: ما مساحة متوازي الأضلاع في \(\mathbb{R}^3\) المحدد بمتجهي الضلعين المتجاورين \(\mathbf{u} = \langle 1, \, 2, \, -1 \rangle\) و \(\mathbf{v} = \langle 3, \, 0, \, 2 \rangle\)؟
pool.sol: The area of the parallelogram spanned by \(\mathbf{u}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) is the magnitude of their cross product, \(\|\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}\|\). Compute the cross product: \(\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v} = \langle (2)(2) - (-1)(0), \, (-1)(3) - (1)(2), \, (1)(0) - (2)(3) \rangle = \langle 4, \, -5, \, -6 \rangle\). Taking the magnitude gives \(\|\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}\| = \sqrt{4^2 + (-5)^2 + (-6)^2} = \sqrt{16 + 25 + 36} = \sqrt{77}\).
pool.sol_ar: مساحة متوازي الأضلاع المولد بالمتجهين \(\mathbf{u}\) و \(\mathbf{v}\) هي طول حاصل ضربهما الاتجاهي \(\|\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}\|\). نحسب الضرب الاتجاهي: \(\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v} = \langle (2)(2) - (-1)(0), \, (-1)(3) - (1)(2), \, (1)(0) - (2)(3) \rangle = \langle 4, \, -5, \, -6 \rangle\). بأخذ الطول نحصل على \(\|\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}\| = \sqrt{4^2 + (-5)^2 + (-6)^2} = \sqrt{16 + 25 + 36} = \sqrt{77}\).
hints: The area of a parallelogram spanned by two vectors \(\mathbf{u}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) in \(\mathbb{R}^3\) equals \(\|\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}\|\) (do not divide by \(2\), which is for a triangle).
Evaluate the determinant for \(\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}\), watching the middle sign carefully, to find \(\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v} = \langle 4, \, -5, \, -6 \rangle\).
Compute the magnitude \(\sqrt{4^2 + (-5)^2 + (-6)^2} = \sqrt{16 + 25 + 36} = \sqrt{77}\).
hints_ar: مساحة متوازي الأضلاع المولد بمتجهين \(\mathbf{u}\) و \(\mathbf{v}\) في \(\mathbb{R}^3\) تساوي \(\|\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}\|\) (لا تقسم على \(2\)، فذلك لمساحة المثلث).
احسب محدد الضرب الاتجاهي \(\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v}\) مع الانتباه جيداً لإشارة المركبة الوسطى، لتجد \(\mathbf{u} \times \mathbf{v} = \langle 4, \, -5, \, -6 \rangle\).

pool.text: Let \(g(x, y) = x^2 e^{3y} + 6x - 2y\). What is the mixed second-order partial derivative \(g_{xy}(0, 0)\) evaluated at the origin?
pool.text_ar: لتكن \(g(x, y) = x^2 e^{3y} + 6x - 2y\). ما قيمة المشتقة الجزئية المختلطة من الرتبة الثانية \(g_{xy}(0, 0)\) عند نقطة الأصل؟
pool.sol: First, compute the partial derivative with respect to \(x\) while holding \(y\) constant: \(g_x(x, y) = 2x e^{3y} + 6\). Next, differentiate \(g_x(x, y)\) with respect to \(y\) while holding \(x\) constant: \(g_{xy}(x, y) = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2x e^{3y} + 6) = 6x e^{3y}\). Finally, substitute \((x, y) = (0, 0)\) to get \(g_{xy}(0, 0) = 6(0)e^{0} = 0\).
pool.sol_ar: أولاً، نحسب المشتقة الجزئية بالنسبة إلى \(x\) مع تثبيت \(y\): \(g_x(x, y) = 2x e^{3y} + 6\). بعد ذلك، نشتق \(g_x(x, y)\) بالنسبة إلى \(y\) مع تثبيت \(x\): \(g_{xy}(x, y) = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2x e^{3y} + 6) = 6x e^{3y}\). أخيراً، نعوض \((x, y) = (0, 0)\) لنحصل على \(g_{xy}(0, 0) = 6(0)e^{0} = 0\).
hints: Recall that \(g_{xy}\) means differentiating \(g\) first with respect to \(x\), and then differentiating the resulting expression with respect to \(y\).
Differentiating \(g(x, y)\) with respect to \(x\) gives \(g_x(x, y) = 2x e^{3y} + 6\); now differentiate this result with respect to \(y\).
Since \(g_{xy}(x, y) = 6x e^{3y}\), substituting \(x = 0\) and \(y = 0\) produces \(6(0)e^0 = 0\).
hints_ar: تذكر أن \(g_{xy}\) تعني اشتقاق \(g\) أولاً بالنسبة إلى \(x\)، ثم اشتقاق التعبير الناتج بالنسبة إلى \(y\).
اشتقاق \(g(x, y)\) بالنسبة إلى \(x\) يعطي \(g_x(x, y) = 2x e^{3y} + 6\)؛ الآن اشتق هذه النتيجة بالنسبة إلى \(y\).
بما أن \(g_{xy}(x, y) = 6x e^{3y}\)، فإن تعويض \(x = 0\) و \(y = 0\) يعطي \(6(0)e^0 = 0\).
pool.sympy_cert: x, y = sp.symbols('x y'); g = x**2 * sp.exp(3*y) + 6*x - 2*y; g_xy = sp.diff(g, x, y); EXPECTED = g_xy.subs({x: 0, y: 0})

pool.text: Let \(f(x, y) = x^2 - 3xy + 2y^2\). Find the magnitude \(\|\nabla f(2, 1)\|\) of the gradient vector of \(f\) at the point \((2, 1)\).
pool.text_ar: لتكن \(f(x, y) = x^2 - 3xy + 2y^2\). أوجد مقدار متجه التدرج \(\|\nabla f(2, 1)\|\) للدالة \(f\) عند النقطة \((2, 1)\).
pool.sol:
The gradient vector is \(
abla f(x, y) = \langle f_x(x, y), f_y(x, y) angle\). Computing the partial derivatives gives \(f_x(x, y) = 2x - 3y\) and \(f_y(x, y) = -3x + 4y\). Evaluating at \((2, 1)\), we have \(f_x(2, 1) = 2(2) - 3(1) = 1\) and \(f_y(2, 1) = -3(2) + 4(1) = -2\), so \(
abla f(2, 1) = \langle 1, -2 angle\). Its magnitude is \(\|
abla f(2, 1)\| = \sqrt{1^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{1 + 4} = \sqrt{5}\).
pool.sol_ar:
متجه التدرج هو \(
abla f(x, y) = \langle f_x(x, y), f_y(x, y) angle\). بحساب المشتقات الجزئية نجد \(f_x(x, y) = 2x - 3y\) و \(f_y(x, y) = -3x + 4y\). بالتعويض عند النقطة \((2, 1)\)، نحصل على \(f_x(2, 1) = 2(2) - 3(1) = 1\) و \(f_y(2, 1) = -3(2) + 4(1) = -2\)، وبالتالي فإن \(
abla f(2, 1) = \langle 1, -2 angle\). مقداره هو \(\|
abla f(2, 1)\| = \sqrt{1^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{1 + 4} = \sqrt{5}\).
hints: The gradient vector \(\nabla f(x, y)\) has components \(\langle f_x(x, y), f_y(x, y) \rangle\).
Compute \(f_x(x, y) = 2x - 3y\) and \(f_y(x, y) = -3x + 4y\), then evaluate both components at \((x, y) = (2, 1)\).
At \((2, 1)\), the gradient vector is \(\langle 1, -2 \rangle\), whose Euclidean norm is \(\sqrt{1^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{5}\).
hints_ar: متجه التدرج \(\nabla f(x, y)\) له المركبتان \(\langle f_x(x, y), f_y(x, y) \rangle\).
احسب \(f_x(x, y) = 2x - 3y\) و \(f_y(x, y) = -3x + 4y\)، ثم عوّض في كلتا المركبتين عند \((x, y) = (2, 1)\).
عند النقطة \((2, 1)\)، يكون متجه التدرج \(\langle 1, -2 \rangle\)، ومقداره الإقليدي هو \(\sqrt{1^2 + (-2)^2} = \sqrt{5}\).
pool.sympy_cert: x, y = sp.symbols('x y'); f = x**2 - 3*x*y + 2*y**2; gx = sp.diff(f, x).subs({x: 2, y: 1}); gy = sp.diff(f, y).subs({x: 2, y: 1}); EXPECTED = sp.sqrt(gx**2 + gy**2)

pool.text: Let \(\mathbf{F}(x, y, z) = (3x^2 y)\mathbf{i} + (2y z^2)\mathbf{j} - (4z)\mathbf{k}\) be a vector field in \(\mathbb{R}^3\). What is the divergence \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F}\) evaluated at the point \((1, 2, -1)\)?
pool.text_ar: ليكن \(\mathbf{F}(x, y, z) = (3x^2 y)\mathbf{i} + (2y z^2)\mathbf{j} - (4z)\mathbf{k}\) حقلاً متجهاً في \(\mathbb{R}^3\). ما قيمة التباعد \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F}\) عند النقطة \((1, 2, -1)\)؟
pool.sol: The divergence of a vector field \(\mathbf{F} = P\mathbf{i} + Q\mathbf{j} + R\mathbf{k}\) is given by \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = \frac{\partial P}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial Q}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial R}{\partial z}\). Computing each partial derivative yields \(\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(3x^2 y) = 6xy\), \(\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2y z^2) = 2z^2\), and \(\frac{\partial}{\partial z}(-4z) = -4\). Thus, \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = 6xy + 2z^2 - 4\). Substituting \((x, y, z) = (1, 2, -1)\) gives \(6(1)(2) + 2(-1)^2 - 4 = 12 + 2 - 4 = 10\).
pool.sol_ar: يُعطى تباعد الحقل المتجه \(\mathbf{F} = P\mathbf{i} + Q\mathbf{j} + R\mathbf{k}\) بالعلاقة \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = \frac{\partial P}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial Q}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial R}{\partial z}\). بحساب المشتقات الجزئية نجد أن \(\frac{\partial}{\partial x}(3x^2 y) = 6xy\)، و\(\frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2y z^2) = 2z^2\)، و\(\frac{\partial}{\partial z}(-4z) = -4\). وبذلك يكون \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = 6xy + 2z^2 - 4\). بالتعويض عن النقطة \((x, y, z) = (1, 2, -1)\) نحصل على \(6(1)(2) + 2(-1)^2 - 4 = 12 + 2 - 4 = 10\).
hints: Recall the definition of divergence for \(\mathbf{F} = P\mathbf{i} + Q\mathbf{j} + R\mathbf{k}\): \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = \frac{\partial P}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial Q}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial R}{\partial z}\).
Differentiate each component with respect to its corresponding variable to obtain \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = 6xy + 2z^2 - 4\).
hints_ar: تذكر تعريف التباعد للحقل المتجه \(\mathbf{F} = P\mathbf{i} + Q\mathbf{j} + R\mathbf{k}\): \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = \frac{\partial P}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial Q}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial R}{\partial z}\).
اشتق كل مركبة جزئياً بالنسبة للمتغير المقابل لها لتحصل على \(\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} = 6xy + 2z^2 - 4\).
عوض بالقيم \(x = 1\) و\(y = 2\) و\(z = -1\) في المقدار \(6xy + 2z^2 - 4\) لتحصل على \(12 + 2 - 4 = 10\).
pool.sympy_cert: x, y, z = sp.symbols('x y z'); P, Q, R = 3*x**2*y, 2*y*z**2, -4*z; div_F = sp.diff(P, x) + sp.diff(Q, y) + sp.diff(R, z); EXPECTED = div_F.subs({x: 1, y: 2, z: -1})

pool.text: Let \(\mathbf{F}(x, y) = \nabla f(x, y)\) be a conservative vector field where the potential function is \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + 3y^2\). Find the value of the line integral \(\int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}\) along a smooth curve \(C\) from the point \((1, 0)\) to the point \((2, 1)\).
pool.text_ar: ليكن \(\mathbf{F}(x, y) = \nabla f(x, y)\) حقلاً متجهاً محافظاً دالة جهده هي \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + 3y^2\). أوجد قيمة التكامل الخطي \(\int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}\) على طول منحنى أملس \(C\) من النقطة \((1, 0)\) إلى النقطة \((2, 1)\).
pool.sol: By the Fundamental Theorem for Line Integrals, if \(\mathbf{F} = \nabla f\) is continuous and \(C\) is a smooth curve from point \(A\) to point \(B\), then \(\int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = f(B) - f(A)\). Here \(A = (1, 0)\) and \(B = (2, 1)\). Evaluating the potential function at both endpoints gives \(f(2, 1) = (2)^2(1) + 3(1)^2 = 4 + 3 = 7\) and \(f(1, 0) = (1)^2(0) + 3(0)^2 = 0\). Subtracting these values gives \(f(2, 1) - f(1, 0) = 7 - 0 = 7\).
pool.sol_ar: بموجب النظرية الأساسية للتكاملات الخطية، إذا كان \(\mathbf{F} = \nabla f\) متصلاً وكان \(C\) منحنى أملس من النقطة \(A\) إلى النقطة \(B\)، فإن \(\int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = f(B) - f(A)\). لدينا هنا \(A = (1, 0)\) و\(B = (2, 1)\). بحساب قيمة دالة الجهد عند نقطتي النهاية والبداية نجد \(f(2, 1) = (2)^2(1) + 3(1)^2 = 4 + 3 = 7\) و\(f(1, 0) = (1)^2(0) + 3(0)^2 = 0\). بطرح هاتين القيمتين نحصل على \(f(2, 1) - f(1, 0) = 7 - 0 = 7\).
hints: Apply the Fundamental Theorem for Line Integrals, which states that the integral of a gradient field \(\nabla f\) depends only on the endpoints of \(C\).
Compute \(f(1, 0)\) at the starting point and \(f(2, 1)\) at the ending point using \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + 3y^2\).
hints_ar: طبق النظرية الأساسية للتكاملات الخطية، والتي تنص على أن تكامل حقل التدرج \(\nabla f\) يعتمد فقط على نقطتي البداية والنهاية للمنحنى \(C\).
احسب \(f(1, 0)\) عند نقطة البداية و\(f(2, 1)\) عند نقطة النهاية باستخدام \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + 3y^2\).
pool.sympy_cert: x, y = sp.symbols('x y'); f = x**2*y + 3*y**2; EXPECTED = f.subs({x: 2, y: 1}) - f.subs({x: 1, y: 0})

pool.text: Use Green's Theorem to evaluate the line integral \(\oint_C (-2y\,dx + 3x\,dy)\), where \(C\) is the positively oriented boundary of the rectangle \([0, 2] \times [0, 3]\).
pool.text_ar: استخدم نظرية غرين لحساب التكامل الخطي \(\oint_C (-2y\,dx + 3x\,dy)\)، حيث \(C\) هو المحيط الموجه إيجابياً للمستطيل \([0, 2] \times [0, 3]\).
pool.sol: Green's Theorem states that \(\oint_C (P\,dx + Q\,dy) = \iint_D \left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right) dA\), where \(D\) is the region enclosed by \(C\). Here \(P(x, y) = -2y\) and \(Q(x, y) = 3x\), so \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = 3\) and \(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = -2\). Thus, \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = 3 - (-2) = 5\). Integrating this constant over the rectangle \(D = [0, 2] \times [0, 3]\), whose area is \(2 \times 3 = 6\), gives \(\iint_D 5\,dA = 5 \times 6 = 30\).
pool.sol_ar: تنص نظرية غرين على أن \(\oint_C (P\,dx + Q\,dy) = \iint_D \left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right) dA\)، حيث \(D\) هي المنطقة المحصورة داخل المنحنى \(C\). لدينا هنا \(P(x, y) = -2y\) و\(Q(x, y) = 3x\)، وعليه فإن \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = 3\) و\(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = -2\). إذن \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = 3 - (-2) = 5\). بمكاملة هذا الثابت على المستطيل \(D = [0, 2] \times [0, 3]\) الذي مساحته \(2 \times 3 = 6\)، نحصل على \(\iint_D 5\,dA = 5 \times 6 = 30\).
hints: Identify \(P(x, y) = -2y\) and \(Q(x, y) = 3x\), and recall Green's Theorem: \(\oint_C (P\,dx + Q\,dy) = \iint_D \left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right) dA\).
Compute the integrand \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = 3 - (-2) = 5\).
Multiply the constant integrand \(5\) by the area of the rectangle \([0, 2] \times [0, 3]\), giving \(5 \times (2 \times 3) = 30\).
hints_ar: حدد الدالتين \(P(x, y) = -2y\) و\(Q(x, y) = 3x\)، وتذكر صيغة نظرية غرين: \(\oint_C (P\,dx + Q\,dy) = \iint_D \left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right) dA\).
احسب المقدار داخل التكامل الثنائي \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = 3 - (-2) = 5\).
اضرب الثابت \(5\) في مساحة المستطيل \([0, 2] \times [0, 3]\) لتحصل على \(5 \times (2 \times 3) = 30\).
pool.sympy_cert: x, y = sp.symbols('x y'); P, Q = -2*y, 3*x; integrand = sp.diff(Q, x) - sp.diff(P, y); EXPECTED = sp.integrate(sp.integrate(integrand, (x, 0, 2)), (y, 0, 3))

pool.text: Let \(f(x, y) = x^2 y \sin(x y)\). What is the value of the partial derivative \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\) evaluated at the point \(\left(1, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)?
pool.text_ar: لتكن \(f(x, y) = x^2 y \sin(x y)\). ما قيمة المشتقة الجزئية \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\) عند النقطة \(\left(1, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\)؟
pool.sol: Treat \(y\) as a constant and apply the product rule along with the chain rule to differentiate \(f(x, y) = x^2 y \sin(x y)\) with respect to \(x\): \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = 2 x y \sin(x y) + x^2 y \cos(x y) \cdot y = 2 x y \sin(x y) + x^2 y^2 \cos(x y)\). Substitute \(x = 1\) and \(y = \frac{\pi}{2}\): \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\left(1, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 2(1)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) + (1)^2\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^2\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = \pi(1) + \frac{\pi^2}{4}(0) = \pi\).
pool.sol_ar: نعتبر \(y\) ثابتًا ونطبق قاعدة الضرب مع قاعدة السلسلة لاشتقاق \(f(x, y) = x^2 y \sin(x y)\) بالنسبة إلى \(x\): \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = 2 x y \sin(x y) + x^2 y \cos(x y) \cdot y = 2 x y \sin(x y) + x^2 y^2 \cos(x y)\). نعوض \(x = 1\) و \(y = \frac{\pi}{2}\): \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\left(1, \frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 2(1)\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) + (1)^2\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)^2\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = \pi(1) + \frac{\pi^2}{4}(0) = \pi\).
hints: Treat \(y\) as a constant and notice that \(x\) appears both in \(x^2 y\) and inside \(\sin(x y)\), requiring the product rule.
Differentiating gives \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = 2 x y \sin(x y) + x^2 y^2 \cos(x y)\).
Evaluate at \(x = 1\) and \(y = \frac{\pi}{2}\) using \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 1\) and \(\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 0\) to obtain \(\pi\).
hints_ar: اعتبر \(y\) ثابتًا ولاحظ أن \(x\) يظهر في كل من \(x^2 y\) وداخل \(\sin(x y)\)، مما يتطلب استخدام قاعدة الضرب.
يعطي الاشتقاق \(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = 2 x y \sin(x y) + x^2 y^2 \cos(x y)\).
عوّض \(x = 1\) و \(y = \frac{\pi}{2}\) مستخدمًا \(\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 1\) و \(\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 0\) لتحصل على \(\pi\).
pool.sympy_cert: x, y = sp.symbols('x y'); f = x**2 * y * sp.sin(x*y); EXPECTED = sp.diff(f, x).subs({x: 1, y: sp.pi/2})

pool.text: Suppose \(z = u^2 - 3 u v\), where \(u = x + 2y\) and \(v = x y\). Using the multivariable chain rule, find \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\) at \((x, y) = (2, 1)\).
pool.text_ar: افترض أن \(z = u^2 - 3 u v\)، حيث \(u = x + 2y\) و \(v = x y\). باستخدام قاعدة السلسلة للدوال متعددة المتغيرات، أوجد \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\) عند \((x, y) = (2, 1)\).
pool.sol: By the multivariable chain rule, \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\). First compute the partial derivatives: \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} = 2u - 3v\), \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial v} = -3u\), \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 2\), and \(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = x\). At \((x, y) = (2, 1)\), we have \(u = 2 + 2(1) = 4\) and \(v = 2(1) = 2\). Evaluating the partial derivatives gives \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} = 2(4) - 3(2) = 2\), \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial v} = -3(4) = -12\), \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 2\), and \(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 2\). Substituting into the chain rule gives \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = (2)(2) + (-12)(2) = 4 - 24 = -20\).
pool.sol_ar: باستخدام قاعدة السلسلة للدوال متعددة المتغيرات، \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\). نحسب المشتقات الجزئية أولاً: \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} = 2u - 3v\)، و \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial v} = -3u\)، و \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 2\)، و \(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = x\). عند النقطة \((x, y) = (2, 1)\)، نجد أن \(u = 2 + 2(1) = 4\) و \(v = 2(1) = 2\). بالتعويض في المشتقات الجزئية نحصل على \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} = 2(4) - 3(2) = 2\)، و \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial v} = -3(4) = -12\)، و \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 2\)، و \(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = 2\). وبالتعويض في قاعدة السلسلة نجد \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = (2)(2) + (-12)(2) = 4 - 24 = -20\).
hints: Write out the two-branch chain rule formula: \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\).
At \((x, y) = (2, 1)\), evaluate \(u = 4\) and \(v = 2\), then find \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} = 2u - 3v = 2\) and \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial v} = -3u = -12\).
Multiply by \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 2\) and \(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = x = 2\), then sum \((2)(2) + (-12)(2)\) to get \(-20\).
hints_ar: اكتب صيغة قاعدة السلسلة ذات الفرعين: \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\).
عند \((x, y) = (2, 1)\)، احسب \(u = 4\) و \(v = 2\)، ثم أوجد \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} = 2u - 3v = 2\) و \(\frac{\partial z}{\partial v} = -3u = -12\).
اضرب في \(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = 2\) و \(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = x = 2\)، ثم اجمع \((2)(2) + (-12)(2)\) لتحصل على \(-20\).
pool.sympy_cert: x, y = sp.symbols('x y'); u = x + 2*y; v = x*y; z = u**2 - 3*u*v; EXPECTED = sp.diff(z, y).subs({x: 2, y: 1})

pool.text: Evaluate the iterated integral \(\int_{0}^{2} \int_{0}^{3} (2x + y) \, dy \, dx\).
pool.text_ar: احسب قيمة التكامل المتكرر \(\int_{0}^{2} \int_{0}^{3} (2x + y) \, dy \, dx\).
pool.sol: First, evaluate the inner integral with respect to \(y\), treating \(x\) as a constant: \(\int_{0}^{3} (2x + y) \, dy = \left[ 2xy + \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_{y=0}^{y=3} = 6x + \frac{9}{2}\). Next, integrate the resulting expression with respect to \(x\) from \(0\) to \(2\): \(\int_{0}^{2} \left( 6x + \frac{9}{2} \right) \, dx = \left[ 3x^2 + \frac{9}{2}x \right]_{0}^{2} = 3(4) + \frac{9}{2}(2) = 12 + 9 = 21\).
pool.sol_ar: أولاً، نحسب التكامل الداخلي بالنسبة إلى المتغير \(y\) مع اعتبار \(x\) ثابتاً: \(\int_{0}^{3} (2x + y) \, dy = \left[ 2xy + \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_{y=0}^{y=3} = 6x + \frac{9}{2}\). بعد ذلك، نكامل العبارة الناتجة بالنسبة إلى \(x\) من \(0\) إلى \(2\): \(\int_{0}^{2} \left( 6x + \frac{9}{2} \right) \, dx = \left[ 3x^2 + \frac{9}{2}x \right]_{0}^{2} = 3(4) + \frac{9}{2}(2) = 12 + 9 = 21\).
hints: Start by integrating the inner integrand \(2x + y\) with respect to \(y\) while holding \(x\) fixed.
Evaluating \(\left[ 2xy + \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_{y=0}^{y=3}\) simplifies the inner integral to \(6x + \frac{9}{2}\).
Integrate \(6x + \frac{9}{2}\) with respect to \(x\) from \(0\) to \(2\) to obtain \(12 + 9 = 21\).
hints_ar: ابدأ بمكاملة الدالة الداخلية \(2x + y\) بالنسبة إلى \(y\) مع تثبيت \(x\).
حساب \(\left[ 2xy + \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_{y=0}^{y=3}\) يبسط التكامل الداخلي إلى \(6x + \frac{9}{2}\).
كامل \(6x + \frac{9}{2}\) بالنسبة إلى \(x\) من \(0\) إلى \(2\) لتحصل على \(12 + 9 = 21\).
pool.sympy_cert:
x, y = sp.symbols('x y')
EXPECTED = sp.integrate(sp.integrate(2*x + y, (y, 0, 3)), (x, 0, 2))

pool.text: Let \(D\) be the region in the first quadrant bounded by \(y = 0\), \(x = 2\), and \(y = x^2\). Evaluate \(\iint_{D} 3x \, dA\).
pool.text_ar: لتكن \(D\) المنطقة الواقعة في الربع الأول والمحدودة بالمستقيمين \(y = 0\) و \(x = 2\) والمنحنى \(y = x^2\). احسب قيمة التكامل الثنائي \(\iint_{D} 3x \, dA\).
pool.sol: The region \(D\) is vertically simple with \(0 \le x \le 2\) and \(0 \le y \le x^2\). Express the double integral as an iterated integral: \(\int_{0}^{2} \int_{0}^{x^2} 3x \, dy \, dx\). Evaluating the inner integral gives \(\int_{0}^{x^2} 3x \, dy = \left[ 3xy \right]_{y=0}^{y=x^2} = 3x^3\). Integrating with respect to \(x\) yields \(\int_{0}^{2} 3x^3 \, dx = \left[ \frac{3}{4}x^4 \right]_{0}^{2} = \frac{3}{4}(16) = 12\).
pool.sol_ar: المنطقة \(D\) بسيطة رأسياً حيث \(0 \le x \le 2\) و \(0 \le y \le x^2\). نكتب التكامل الثنائي على صورة تكامل متكرر: \(\int_{0}^{2} \int_{0}^{x^2} 3x \, dy \, dx\). بحساب التكامل الداخلي نحصل على \(\int_{0}^{x^2} 3x \, dy = \left[ 3xy \right]_{y=0}^{y=x^2} = 3x^3\). وبالمكاملة بالنسبة إلى \(x\) ينتج \(\int_{0}^{2} 3x^3 \, dx = \left[ \frac{3}{4}x^4 \right]_{0}^{2} = \frac{3}{4}(16) = 12\).
hints: Describe the region \(D\) using vertical slices where \(x\) ranges from \(0\) to \(2\) and \(y\) ranges from \(0\) to \(x^2\).
Integrating \(3x\) with respect to \(y\) from \(0\) to \(x^2\) produces \(3x(x^2 - 0) = 3x^3\).
Evaluate the outer integral \(\int_{0}^{2} 3x^3 \, dx = \left[ \frac{3}{4}x^4 \right]_{0}^{2} = 12\).
hints_ar: صِف المنطقة \(D\) باستخدام شرائح رأسية حيث تتراوح \(x\) من \(0\) إلى \(2\) وتتراوح \(y\) من \(0\) إلى \(x^2\).
مكاملة \(3x\) بالنسبة إلى \(y\) من \(0\) إلى \(x^2\) تعطي \(3x(x^2 - 0) = 3x^3\).
احسب التكامل الخارجي \(\int_{0}^{2} 3x^3 \, dx = \left[ \frac{3}{4}x^4 \right]_{0}^{2} = 12\).
pool.sympy_cert:
x, y = sp.symbols('x y')
EXPECTED = sp.integrate(sp.integrate(3*x, (y, 0, x**2)), (x, 0, 2))

pool.text: By reversing the order of integration, evaluate \(\int_{0}^{1} \int_{y}^{1} e^{x^2} \, dx \, dy\).
pool.text_ar: بتغيير ترتيب التكامل، احسب قيمة \(\int_{0}^{1} \int_{y}^{1} e^{x^2} \, dx \, dy\).
pool.sol: The region of integration satisfies \(0 \le y \le 1\) and \(y \le x \le 1\), which describes the triangle \(0 \le x \le 1\) and \(0 \le y \le x\). Reversing the order of integration gives \(\int_{0}^{1} \int_{0}^{x} e^{x^2} \, dy \, dx\). First integrate with respect to \(y\): \(\int_{0}^{x} e^{x^2} \, dy = x e^{x^2}\). Next, integrate with respect to \(x\) using the substitution \(u = x^2\), \(du = 2x \, dx\): \(\int_{0}^{1} x e^{x^2} \, dx = \left[ \frac{1}{2} e^{x^2} \right]_{0}^{1} = \frac{e - 1}{2}\).
pool.sol_ar: منطقة التكامل تحقق المتباينتين \(0 \le y \le 1\) و \(y \le x \le 1\)، وهي تمثل المثلث المحدد بـ \(0 \le x \le 1\) و \(0 \le y \le x\). بتغيير ترتيب التكامل نحصل على \(\int_{0}^{1} \int_{0}^{x} e^{x^2} \, dy \, dx\). نكامل أولاً بالنسبة إلى \(y\): \(\int_{0}^{x} e^{x^2} \, dy = x e^{x^2}\). ثم نكامل بالنسبة إلى \(x\) باستخدام التعويض \(u = x^2\) و \(du = 2x \, dx\): \(\int_{0}^{1} x e^{x^2} \, dx = \left[ \frac{1}{2} e^{x^2} \right]_{0}^{1} = \frac{e - 1}{2}\).
hints: Sketch the triangular region defined by \(0 \le y \le 1\) and \(y \le x \le 1\) to rewrite the bounds with \(dy\) inside and \(dx\) outside.
In the reversed order \(\int_{0}^{1} \int_{0}^{x} e^{x^2} \, dy \, dx\), the inner integral simplifies to \(x e^{x^2}\).
Use the substitution \(u = x^2\) to evaluate \(\int_{0}^{1} x e^{x^2} \, dx = \frac{e - 1}{2}\).
hints_ar: ارسم المنطقة المثلثية المحددة بـ \(0 \le y \le 1\) و \(y \le x \le 1\) لإعادة كتابة حدود التكامل بحيث يكون \(dy\) بالداخل و \(dx\) بالخارج.
في الترتيب المعكوس \(\int_{0}^{1} \int_{0}^{x} e^{x^2} \, dy \, dx\)، يتبسط التكامل الداخلي إلى \(x e^{x^2}\).
استخدم التعويض \(u = x^2\) لحساب \(\int_{0}^{1} x e^{x^2} \, dx = \frac{e - 1}{2}\).
pool.sympy_cert:
x, y = sp.symbols('x y')
EXPECTED = sp.integrate(sp.integrate(sp.exp(x**2), (y, 0, x)), (x, 0, 1))

pool.text: Let \(D\) be the disk \(x^2 + y^2 \le 4\). Evaluate the double integral \(\iint_{D} (x^2 + y^2) \, dA\) using polar coordinates.
pool.text_ar: ليكن \(D\) القرص \(x^2 + y^2 \le 4\). احسب قيمة التكامل الثنائي \(\iint_{D} (x^2 + y^2) \, dA\) باستخدام الإحداثيات القطبية.
pool.sol: In polar coordinates, \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\) and the area element is \(dA = r \, dr \, d\theta\). The disk \(x^2 + y^2 \le 4\) corresponds to \(0 \le r \le 2\) and \(0 \le \theta \le 2\pi\). Thus, the integral becomes \(\int_{0}^{2\pi} \int_{0}^{2} r^2 \cdot r \, dr \, d\theta = \int_{0}^{2\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{2} r^3 \, dr\). Computing both integrals gives \(2\pi \left[ \frac{r^4}{4} \right]_{0}^{2} = 2\pi \left( \frac{16}{4} \right) = 8\pi\).
pool.sol_ar: في الإحداثيات القطبية، لدينا \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\) وعنصر المساحة هو \(dA = r \, dr \, d\theta\). القرص \(x^2 + y^2 \le 4\) يقابل \(0 \le r \le 2\) و \(0 \le \theta \le 2\pi\). وبالتالي يصبح التكامل \(\int_{0}^{2\pi} \int_{0}^{2} r^2 \cdot r \, dr \, d\theta = \int_{0}^{2\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{2} r^3 \, dr\). بحساب التكاملين نحصل على \(2\pi \left[ \frac{r^4}{4} \right]_{0}^{2} = 2\pi \left( \frac{16}{4} \right) = 8\pi\).
hints: Convert the integrand \(x^2 + y^2\) to \(r^2\) and replace \(dA\) with the polar area element \(r \, dr \, d\theta\).
The disk of radius \(2\) gives limits \(0 \le r \le 2\) and \(0 \le \theta \le 2\pi\), making the radial integrand \(r^3\).
Evaluate \(\int_{0}^{2\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{2} r^3 \, dr = 2\pi \cdot 4 = 8\pi\).
hints_ar: حوّل الدالة المكاملة \(x^2 + y^2\) إلى \(r^2\) واستبدل \(dA\) بعنصر المساحة القطبي \(r \, dr \, d\theta\).
القرص الذي نصف قطره \(2\) يعطي الحدود \(0 \le r \le 2\) و \(0 \le \theta \le 2\pi\)، مما يجعل الدالة القطرية المكاملة \(r^3\).
احسب \(\int_{0}^{2\pi} d\theta \int_{0}^{2} r^3 \, dr = 2\pi \cdot 4 = 8\pi\).
pool.sympy_cert:
r, theta = sp.symbols('r theta')
EXPECTED = sp.integrate(sp.integrate(r**2 * r, (r, 0, 2)), (theta, 0, 2*sp.pi))

pool.text: Find the volume of the solid in the first octant bounded by the coordinate planes \(x = 0\), \(y = 0\), \(z = 0\) and the plane \(z = 4 - 2x - y\).
pool.text_ar: أوجد حجم المجسم الواقع في الثمن الأول والمحدود بمستويات الإحداثيات \(x = 0\) و \(y = 0\) و \(z = 0\) والمستوى \(z = 4 - 2x - y\).
pool.sol: Setting \(z = 0\) in \(z = 4 - 2x - y\) gives the boundary line \(y = 4 - 2x\) in the \(xy\)-plane, where \(0 \le x \le 2\) and \(0 \le y \le 4 - 2x\). The volume is \(V = \int_{0}^{2} \int_{0}^{4-2x} (4 - 2x - y) \, dy \, dx\). Integrating with respect to \(y\) yields \(\left[ (4 - 2x)y - \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_{0}^{4-2x} = \frac{1}{2}(4 - 2x)^2 = 2(2 - x)^2\). Integrating with respect to \(x\) gives \(\int_{0}^{2} 2(2 - x)^2 \, dx = \left[ -\frac{2}{3}(2 - x)^3 \right]_{0}^{2} = \frac{16}{3}\).
pool.sol_ar: بوضع \(z = 0\) في المعادلة \(z = 4 - 2x - y\) نحصل على المستقيم الحدي \(y = 4 - 2x\) في المستوى \(xy\)، حيث \(0 \le x \le 2\) و \(0 \le y \le 4 - 2x\). الحجم يعطى بالتكامل \(V = \int_{0}^{2} \int_{0}^{4-2x} (4 - 2x - y) \, dy \, dx\). بالمكاملة بالنسبة إلى \(y\) ينتج \(\left[ (4 - 2x)y - \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_{0}^{4-2x} = \frac{1}{2}(4 - 2x)^2 = 2(2 - x)^2\). وبالمكاملة بالنسبة إلى \(x\) نحصل على \(\int_{0}^{2} 2(2 - x)^2 \, dx = \left[ -\frac{2}{3}(2 - x)^3 \right]_{0}^{2} = \frac{16}{3}\).
hints: Find the base triangle in the \(xy\)-plane by setting \(z = 0\), which gives \(2x + y = 4\) in the first quadrant.
Set up the volume integral \(\int_{0}^{2} \int_{0}^{4-2x} (4 - 2x - y) \, dy \, dx\) and evaluate the inner integral to obtain \(2(2 - x)^2\).
Integrate \(2(2 - x)^2\) from \(x = 0\) to \(x = 2\) to find the volume \(\frac{16}{3}\).
hints_ar: أوجد مثلث القاعدة في المستوى \(xy\) بوضع \(z = 0\)، مما يعطي \(2x + y = 4\) في الربع الأول.

pool.text: Evaluate the triple integral \(\iiint_{B} 8xyz \, dV\) over the rectangular box \(B = [0, 1] \times [0, 2] \times [0, 3]\).
pool.text_ar: احسب قيمة التكامل الثلاثي \(\iiint_{B} 8xyz \, dV\) على متوازي المستطيلات \(B = [0, 1] \times [0, 2] \times [0, 3]\).
pool.sol: Because the integrand \(8xyz\) is separable and \(B\) is a rectangular box with constant bounds, Fubini's theorem lets us factor the triple integral into a product of three single integrals: \(8 \left( \int_{0}^{1} x \, dx \right) \left( \int_{0}^{2} y \, dy \right) \left( \int_{0}^{3} z \, dz \right)\). Evaluating each factor gives \(8 \cdot \left[ \frac{x^2}{2} \right]_{0}^{1} \cdot \left[ \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_{0}^{2} \cdot \left[ \frac{z^2}{2} \right]_{0}^{3} = 8 \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cdot \frac{9}{2} = 36\).
pool.sol_ar: بما أن الدالة المكاملة \(8xyz\) قابلة للفصل والمنطقة \(B\) متوازي مستطيلات بحدود ثابتة، فإن مبرهنة فوبيني تتيح تحليل التكامل الثلاثي إلى حاصل ضرب ثلاثة تكاملات مفردة: \(8 \left( \int_{0}^{1} x \, dx \right) \left( \int_{0}^{2} y \, dy \right) \left( \int_{0}^{3} z \, dz \right)\). بحساب كل عامل نحصل على \(8 \cdot \left[ \frac{x^2}{2} \right]_{0}^{1} \cdot \left[ \frac{y^2}{2} \right]_{0}^{2} \cdot \left[ \frac{z^2}{2} \right]_{0}^{3} = 8 \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cdot \frac{9}{2} = 36\).
hints: Since \(B\) has constant limits and the integrand is a product \(8xyz\), factor the triple integral into three separate one-variable integrals.
Compute the individual integrals: \(\int_{0}^{1} x \, dx = \frac{1}{2}\), \(\int_{0}^{2} y \, dy = 2\), and \(\int_{0}^{3} z \, dz = \frac{9}{2}\).
Multiply \(8 \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cdot \frac{9}{2}\) to obtain \(36\).
hints_ar: بما أن للمنطقة \(B\) حدوداً ثابتة والدالة المكاملة حاصل ضرب \(8xyz\)، حلّل التكامل الثلاثي إلى ثلاثة تكاملات منفصلة بمتغير واحد.
احسب التكاملات الفردية: \(\int_{0}^{1} x \, dx = \frac{1}{2}\)، و \(\int_{0}^{2} y \, dy = 2\)، و \(\int_{0}^{3} z \, dz = \frac{9}{2}\).
اضرب \(8 \cdot \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2 \cdot \frac{9}{2}\) لتحصل على \(36\).
pool.sympy_cert:
x, y, z = sp.symbols('x y z')
EXPECTED = sp.integrate(8*x*y*z, (x, 0, 1), (y, 0, 2), (z, 0, 3))

pool.text: Find the absolute value of the Jacobian determinant \(\left| \frac{\partial(x, y)}{\partial(u, v)} \right|\) for the linear transformation \(x = 3u + v\), \(y = u - 2v\).
pool.text_ar: أوجد القيمة المطلقة لمحدد جاكوبي \(\left| \frac{\partial(x, y)}{\partial(u, v)} \right|\) للتحويل الخطي \(x = 3u + v\) و \(y = u - 2v\).
pool.sol: Compute the first-order partial derivatives of \(x\) and \(y\) with respect to \(u\) and \(v\): \(\frac{\partial x}{\partial u} = 3\), \(\frac{\partial x}{\partial v} = 1\), \(\frac{\partial y}{\partial u} = 1\), and \(\frac{\partial y}{\partial v} = -2\). The Jacobian determinant is \(\frac{\partial(x, y)}{\partial(u, v)} = (3)(-2) - (1)(1) = -6 - 1 = -7\). Taking the absolute value gives \(|-7| = 7\).
pool.sol_ar: نحسب المشتقات الجزئية من الرتبة الأولى لكل من \(x\) و \(y\) بالنسبة إلى \(u\) و \(v\): \(\frac{\partial x}{\partial u} = 3\)، و \(\frac{\partial x}{\partial v} = 1\)، و \(\frac{\partial y}{\partial u} = 1\)، و \(\frac{\partial y}{\partial v} = -2\). محدد جاكوبي يساوي \(\frac{\partial(x, y)}{\partial(u, v)} = (3)(-2) - (1)(1) = -6 - 1 = -7\). وبأخذ القيمة المطلقة نحصل على \(|-7| = 7\).
hints: Form the \(2 \times 2\) Jacobian matrix using the partial derivatives \(\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}\), \(\frac{\partial x}{\partial v}\), \(\frac{\partial y}{\partial u}\), and \(\frac{\partial y}{\partial v}\).

Evaluating \(\left( \frac{\partial x}{\partial u} \right) \left( \frac{\partial y}{\partial v} \right) - \left( \frac{\partial x}{\partial v} \right) \left( \frac{\partial y}{\partial u} \right)\) gives \((3)(-2) - (1)(1) = -7\).
Take the absolute value of the determinant \(-7\) to obtain \(7\).
hints_ar: كوّن مصفوفة جاكوبي من الرتبة \(2 \times 2\) باستخدام المشتقات الجزئية \(\frac{\partial x}{\partial u}\) و \(\frac{\partial x}{\partial v}\) و \(\frac{\partial y}{\partial u}\) و \(\frac{\partial y}{\partial v}\).

حساب المقدار \(\left( \frac{\partial x}{\partial u} \right) \left( \frac{\partial y}{\partial v} \right) - \left( \frac{\partial x}{\partial v} \right) \left( \frac{\partial y}{\partial u} \right)\) يعطي \((3)(-2) - (1)(1) = -7\).
خذ القيمة المطلقة للمحدد \(-7\) لتحصل على \(7\).
pool.sympy_cert:
u, v = sp.symbols('u v')
x = 3*u + v
y = u - 2*v
J = sp.Matrix([x, y]).jacobian([u, v]).det()
EXPECTED = sp.Abs(J)

pool.text: Let \(\mathbf{F}(x, y) = (2xy + y^2)\,\mathbf{i} + (x^2 + 2xy - 3)\,\mathbf{j}\) be a conservative vector field. Evaluate the line integral \(\int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}\), where \(C\) is the smooth curve given by \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^2, t^3 \rangle\) for \(0 \le t \le 2\).
pool.text_ar: ليكن \(\mathbf{F}(x, y) = (2xy + y^2)\,\mathbf{i} + (x^2 + 2xy - 3)\,\mathbf{j}\) حقلاً متجهياً محافظاً. احسب التكامل الخطي \(\int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r}\)، حيث \(C\) هو المنحنى الأملس المعطى بالعلاقة \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^2, t^3 \rangle\) للفترة \(0 \le t \le 2\).
pool.sol: Since \(\mathbf{F} = \langle P, Q \rangle\) is conservative, we find a potential function \(f(x, y)\) such that \(\nabla f = \mathbf{F}\). Integrating \(f_x = 2xy + y^2\) with respect to \(x\) gives \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + x y^2 + g(y)\). Differentiating with respect to \(y\) yields \(f_y = x^2 + 2xy + g'(y)\). Matching this with \(Q = x^2 + 2xy - 3\) gives \(g'(y) = -3\), so we take \(g(y) = -3y\) and \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + x y^2 - 3y\). The curve \(C\) starts at \(\mathbf{r}(0) = (0, 0)\) and ends at \(\mathbf{r}(2) = (4, 8)\). By the Fundamental Theorem for Line Integrals, \(\int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = f(4, 8) - f(0, 0) = (16 \cdot 8 + 4 \cdot 64 - 3 \cdot 8) - 0 = 128 + 256 - 24 = 360\).
pool.sol_ar: بما أن \(\mathbf{F} = \langle P, Q \rangle\) حقل محافظ، نوجد دالة جهد \(f(x, y)\) تحقق \(\nabla f = \mathbf{F}\). بتكامل \(f_x = 2xy + y^2\) بالنسبة إلى \(x\) نحصل على \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + x y^2 + g(y)\). وبالاشتقاق بالنسبة إلى \(y\) نجد \(f_y = x^2 + 2xy + g'(y)\). وبمقارنة ذلك مع \(Q = x^2 + 2xy - 3\) ينتج \(g'(y) = -3\)، فنختار \(g(y) = -3y\) وتكون \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + x y^2 - 3y\). يبدأ المنحنى \(C\) عند \(\mathbf{r}(0) = (0, 0)\) وينتهي عند \(\mathbf{r}(2) = (4, 8)\). وبموجب النظرية الأساسية للتكاملات الخطية، فإن \(\int_C \mathbf{F} \cdot d\mathbf{r} = f(4, 8) - f(0, 0) = (16 \cdot 8 + 4 \cdot 64 - 3 \cdot 8) - 0 = 128 + 256 - 24 = 360\).
hints: Because the vector field is conservative, the line integral depends only on the endpoints of \(C\). Find a scalar potential function \(f(x, y)\) satisfying \(\nabla f = \mathbf{F}\).

Integrate \(f_x = 2xy + y^2\) with respect to \(x\) and match \(f_y\) with \(x^2 + 2xy - 3\) to obtain \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + x y^2 - 3y\). Also determine the initial point \(\mathbf{r}(0)\) and terminal point \(\mathbf{r}(2)\).
hints_ar: بما أن الحقل المتجهي محافظ، فإن التكامل الخطي يعتمد فقط على نقطتي البداية والنهاية للمنحنى \(C\). أوجد دالة جهد قياسية \(f(x, y)\) تحقق \(\nabla f = \mathbf{F}\).
كامل \(f_x = 2xy + y^2\) بالنسبة إلى \(x\) وطابق \(f_y\) مع \(x^2 + 2xy - 3\) للحصول على \(f(x, y) = x^2 y + x y^2 - 3y\). حدد أيضاً نقطة البداية \(\mathbf{r}(0)\) ونقطة النهاية \(\mathbf{r}(2)\).
pool.sympy_cert: t = sp.Symbol('t', real=True); x = t**2; y = t**3; P = 2*x*y + y**2; Q = x**2 + 2*x*y - 3; EXPECTED = sp.integrate(P*sp.diff(x, t) + Q*sp.diff(y, t), (t, 0, 2))

pool.text: Use Green's Theorem to evaluate the line integral \(\oint_C (y^2 - 2y)\,dx + (3x + 2xy)\,dy\), where \(C\) is the positively oriented circle \(x^2 + y^2 = 9\).
pool.text_ar: استخدم نظرية غرين لحساب التكامل الخطي \(\oint_C (y^2 - 2y)\,dx + (3x + 2xy)\,dy\)، حيث \(C\) هي الدائرة الموجهة إيجابياً \(x^2 + y^2 = 9\).
pool.sol: Let \(P(x, y) = y^2 - 2y\) and \(Q(x, y) = 3x + 2xy\). The partial derivatives are \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = 3 + 2y\) and \(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = 2y - 2\). By Green's Theorem, \(\oint_C P\,dx + Q\,dy = \iint_D \left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right)\,dA\), where \(D\) is the disk \(x^2 + y^2 \le 9\). Simplifying the integrand gives \((3 + 2y) - (2y - 2) = 5\). Thus the integral equals \(5 \iint_D dA = 5 \cdot \text{Area}(D)\). Since \(D\) is a disk of radius \(3\), its area is \(9\pi\), giving \(5(9\pi) = 45\pi\).
pool.sol_ar: لتكن \(P(x, y) = y^2 - 2y\) و \(Q(x, y) = 3x + 2xy\). المشتقتان الجزئيتان هما \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = 3 + 2y\) و \(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = 2y - 2\). بموجب نظرية غرين، فإن \(\oint_C P\,dx + Q\,dy = \iint_D \left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right)\,dA\)، حيث \(D\) هو القرص \(x^2 + y^2 \le 9\). بتبسيط الدالة المكاملة نحصل على \((3 + 2y) - (2y - 2) = 5\). وبالتالي يساوي التكامل \(5 \iint_D dA\)، أي خمسة أضعاف مساحة القرص \(D\). وبما أن \(D\) قرص نصف قطره \(3\)، فإن مساحته تساوي \(9\pi\)، مما يعطي \(5(9\pi) = 45\pi\).
hints: Apply Green's Theorem: \(\oint_C P\,dx + Q\,dy = \iint_D \left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right)\,dA\), where \(D\) is the disk enclosed by \(x^2 + y^2 = 9\).
Compute \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = 3 + 2y\) and \(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = 2y - 2\), then subtract them carefully so the \(2y\) terms cancel.
The integrand simplifies to the constant \(5\), and the disk \(x^2 + y^2 \le 9\) has radius \(3\) and area \(9\pi\), so the integral equals \(5 \cdot 9\pi = 45\pi\).
hints_ar: طبّق نظرية غرين: \(\oint_C P\,dx + Q\,dy = \iint_D \left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right)\,dA\)، حيث \(D\) هو القرص المحاط بالدائرة \(x^2 + y^2 = 9\).
احسب \(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x} = 3 + 2y\) و \(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y} = 2y - 2\)، ثم اطرحهما بعناية بحيث يُحذف الحد \(2y\).
تتبسط الدالة المكاملة إلى الثابت \(5\)، وبما أن القرص \(x^2 + y^2 \le 9\) نصف قطره \(3\) ومساحته \(9\pi\)، فإن التكامل يساوي \(5 \cdot 9\pi = 45\pi\).
pool.sympy_cert: x, y, r, theta = sp.symbols('x y r theta', real=True); P = y**2 - 2*y; Q = 3*x + 2*x*y; curl_z = sp.diff(Q, x) - sp.diff(P, y); EXPECTED = sp.integrate(sp.integrate(curl_z.subs({x: r*sp.cos(theta), y: r*sp.sin(theta)}) * r, (r, 0, 3)), (theta, 0, 2*sp.pi))

pool.text: Evaluate the definite integral \(\int_{1}^{e} x^2 \ln(x) \, dx\).
pool.text_ar: احسب قيمة التكامل المحدود \(\int_{1}^{e} x^2 \ln(x) \, dx\).
pool.sol: Use integration by parts with \(u = \ln(x)\) and \(dv = x^2 \, dx\). Then \(du = \frac{1}{x} \, dx\) and \(v = \frac{x^3}{3}\). Applying \(\int u \, dv = uv - \int v \, du\), we obtain \(\left[ \frac{x^3}{3} \ln(x) \right]_{1}^{e} - \int_{1}^{e} \frac{x^3}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{x} \, dx = \left( \frac{e^3}{3} \ln(e) - \frac{1}{3} \ln(1) \right) - \frac{1}{3} \int_{1}^{e} x^2 \, dx\). Since \(\ln(e) = 1\) and \(\ln(1) = 0\), this simplifies to \(\frac{e^3}{3} - \left[ \frac{x^3}{9} \right]_{1}^{e} = \frac{e^3}{3} - \left( \frac{e^3}{9} - \frac{1}{9} \right) = \frac{3e^3 - e^3 + 1}{9} = \frac{2e^3 + 1}{9}\).
pool.sol_ar: استخدم التكامل بالأجزاء بفرض أن \(u = \ln(x)\) و \(dv = x^2 \, dx\). وعليه فإن \(du = \frac{1}{x} \, dx\) و \(v = \frac{x^3}{3}\). بتطبيق القاعدة \(\int u \, dv = uv - \int v \, du\)، نحصل على \(\left[ \frac{x^3}{3} \ln(x) \right]_{1}^{e} - \int_{1}^{e} \frac{x^3}{3} \cdot \frac{1}{x} \, dx = \left( \frac{e^3}{3} \ln(e) - \frac{1}{3} \ln(1) \right) - \frac{1}{3} \int_{1}^{e} x^2 \, dx\). بما أن \(\ln(e) = 1\) و \(\ln(1) = 0\)، يتبسط المقدار إلى \(\frac{e^3}{3} - \left[ \frac{x^3}{9} \right]_{1}^{e} = \frac{e^3}{3} - \left( \frac{e^3}{9} - \frac{1}{9} \right) = \frac{3e^3 - e^3 + 1}{9} = \frac{2e^3 + 1}{9}\).
hints: Apply integration by parts \(\int u \, dv = uv - \int v \, du\), choosing \(u = \ln(x)\) so its derivative simplifies the logarithm.
With \(u = \ln(x)\) and \(dv = x^2 \, dx\), compute \(du = \frac{1}{x} \, dx\) and \(v = \frac{x^3}{3}\), turning the remaining integral into \(\int_{1}^{e} \frac{x^2}{3} \, dx\).
Evaluate \(\left[ \frac{x^3}{3} \ln(x) - \frac{x^3}{9} \right]_{1}^{e}\) using \(\ln(e) = 1\) and \(\ln(1) = 0\) to obtain \(\frac{2e^3 + 1}{9}\).
hints_ar: طبّق التكامل بالأجزاء \(\int u \, dv = uv - \int v \, du\)، باختيار \(u = \ln(x)\) بحيث تبسّط مشتقته اللوغاريتم.
بفرض \(u = \ln(x)\) و \(dv = x^2 \, dx\)، احسب \(du = \frac{1}{x} \, dx\) و \(v = \frac{x^3}{3}\)، مما يحوّل التكامل المتبقي إلى \(\int_{1}^{e} \frac{x^2}{3} \, dx\).
احسب قيمة \(\left[ \frac{x^3}{3} \ln(x) - \frac{x^3}{9} \right]_{1}^{e}\) باستخدام \(\ln(e) = 1\) و \(\ln(1) = 0\) لتحصل على \(\frac{2e^3 + 1}{9}\).
